title: 'New Shift' is no longer offered in the grid cell context menu
refs: SV-8700 (§7 (Right-click context menu - New Shift),§14.1 (creation via context menu))
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on a desktop browser with Schedule: Edit.
2. Schedulable work order lines exist.
3. You are on the Schedule page in week view.
custom_steps:
1. Right-click a technician's grid cell.
2. Read the menu items.
custom_expected:
1. The context menu shows only 'Create Event' and 'New Work Order'.
2. There is no 'New Shift' item - it was removed from the menu.
